Customers subscribe on an out-of-stock product through the Store API POST /api/v3/store/products/:product_id/back_in_stock_subscriptions (guest-accessible, rate-limited; body {email}, normalized/downcased; find_or_initialize_by(product,email) re-activates a previously-notified subscription; 404 when product missing). Email delivery uses the store's configured SMTP (Resend: smtp.resend.com / SMTP_USERNAME=resend / SMTP_PASSWORD=re_... in server .env only). Admin lists/deletes subscriptions at /admin/back_in_stock_subscriptions (settings nav, table with product/email/status/created_at).

scenarios.description: After rolling back to 2155920 (no order-split/combined-payment), three regressions resurfaced: (1) the PDP crashed with `TypeError: b?.toFixed is not a function` because ProductReviews rendered `averageRating?.toFixed(1)` while the Store API serializes average_rating as a string (BigDecimal) — fixed by wrapping in Number(). scenarios.description: FIN-P4-8（PRD-20260906-payments-fin-p4-8）：运维闭环收官。FinancialLedger::RepairTransaction（Journal 幂等补记 §49）：枚举 txn 可达 payments/refunds/splits 按 journal-missing 分区（already_present vs 缺失），修复委托 PostPayment/PostRefund/PostAllocation 幂等原语；绝不重新 Payment/Refund/改 state/自动 charge（INV-08/09）。Reconciliations::ReconcileSweeperJob（sidekiq-cron 保守自动，参考 RecoverSweeperJob）：扫描 completed/payment_confirmed/finalizing → 逐个 ReconcileTransaction（只读）统计 status_counts（event=reconciliations.sweeper metrics）；journal-missing 自动 enqueue RepairTransactionJob（幂等安全 §44）；mismatch/needs_attention/pending 绝不自动动资金，仅 warn（§46 人工）。reconciliations.rake：list_needs_attention/reconcile[txn]/repair[txn]/backfill[store]。Backfill 三类（§50/AC-4025）：PROVABLE→补 journal；PARTIALLY_PROVABLE→只补本地+PENDING/UNSUPPORTED 如实；UNPROVABLE→不写不猜保留 legacy。无 migration（legacy 处置沿用既有 journal/UNSUPPORTED 语义）；admin UI/timeline/audit 目录范围外；全量 backend-rspec 0 failures
mustDo: RepairTransaction 幂等补记：captured payment 缺 CASH_CAPTURED / succeeded refund 缺 REFUND_SUCCEEDED / settled combination splits 缺 ORDER_ALLOCATION → 补记（委托既有幂等原语）
repair 绝不重新 Payment/Refund/改任何 state machine/自动 charge（INV-08/09/12，唯一写 = Journal）
repair 幂等：重复运行不重复 entry；already_present 统计正确；不可证明源（无 provider reference 等）不修不猜
ReconcileSweeperJob 保守自动：journal-missing → 自动 enqueue RepairTransactionJob；mismatch/needs_attention → 仅 warn 不自动动资金（§44/§46）
sweeper 输出结构化 metrics（event/reconciliations.sweeper/store_id/status_counts/needs_human）；重复运行无副作用
rake list_needs_attention/reconcile/repair/backfill 存在且可执行
backfill 三类：PROVABLE 补 journal；PARTIALLY 只补本地 + PENDING/UNSUPPORTED 如实；UNPROVABLE 不写不猜（AC-4025）
全链路只读/幂等：零自动 charge/refund、零新 Payment/Refund、零 transaction state 倒退
mustNotDo: repair/sweeper/backfill 触发重新 Payment/Refund/charge 或倒退 transaction state（INV-08/09 必须禁止）
sweeper 对 mismatch/needs_attention/provider 冲突自动动资金（§46 必须人工，仅 journal-missing 自动）
refund 无 provider reference 等不可证明源被 repair（必须不修不猜）
backfill UNPROVABLE 猜 captured/ownership/currency 或写半套事实（AC-4025/§50 必须保留 legacy）
在 FIN-P4-8 做 Admin Financial View UI / Financial Timeline / finance.* audit 目录（范围外）或加 migration
repair 绕过既有幂等 Post 原语直接 create entry（必须委托 PostPayment/PostRefund/PostAllocation）

scenarios.name: REV-P6-1 Durable Refund Lifecycle：Refund = durable execution aggregate（requested→processing→succeeded/failed/ambiguous），闭合 orphan PSP refund
scenarios.description: REV-P6-1（PRD-20260906-payments-rev-p6-1-durable-refund-lifecycle-foundation）：Refund 由 successful-refund-only row 升级为带状态机（requested/processing/succeeded/failed/ambiguous/manual_review/canceled）的 Durable Refund Execution Aggregate；删除 after_create :perform!「create 即 PSP 副作用」；新增 Refunds::Execute（claim 锁内重校验 capacity→provider I/O→三态持久化，ApplySuccess 独立可重放）；Payment#refundable_capacity = amount − succeeded − active(requested/processing/ambiguous)，failed/canceled 释放；仅 refund.succeeded → PostRefund（REFUND_SUCCEEDED）；历史 backfill state=succeeded（transaction_id 存在）不猜 ownership。
mustDo: 任何 PSP refund 副作用前本地必有 durable Refund row（AC-6001）；Refund 创建失败不得调用 PSP（AC-6002）

requested/processing/ambiguous 占用 refundable capacity（AC-6007/6008）；FAILED 释放（AC-6009）；并发 partial refund 不超付
timeout/未知结果 → ambiguous，不自动创建第二笔 Refund（AC-6005）；明确拒绝 → failed durable 留痕（不 raise 回滚）
PSP success + 本地投影失败 → durable row 保持 processing/ambiguous（可 ApplySuccess 重放，AC-6006 底座）
仅 SUCCEEDED 触发 REFUND_SUCCEEDED journal posting（AC-6013/6014）；非 succeeded 不误入账
P0-P5 baseline 全绿（AC-6030~6035）；新增 lifecycle/capacity/execute spec + 受影响 refund/gateway/reimbursement/P4 posting spec 全绿
mustNotDo: 保留 after_create :perform! / create 内同步 PSP（REV-INV-03 反例）
ambiguous 结果自动重退或猜 FAILED 再退一次（REV-INV-04/16）
failed/canceled/requested 退款减少 payment_total 或产生 REFUND_SUCCEEDED ledger entry
Refund 失败 raise 回滚丢弃 durable 记录（无本地 owner 的 orphan PSP refund）
回退 CommerceTransaction/Payment 或建 ReverseTransaction/第二套 Refund ownership

scenarios.description: REV-P6-2（PRD-20260906-payments-rev-p6-2-refund-execution-orchestration）：退款发起与资金执行解耦——Refunds::Request（capacity 校验 → durable requested → enqueue ExecuteJob）为唯一发起入口；ExecuteJob（Sidekiq）async 执行 Refunds::Execute；Admin refunds#create 与 Stripe/Adyen/PayPal gateway cancel 自动退款改为 async（201 state=requested / 立即成功，退款后台执行）；reimbursement 退货链本包保留同步（REV-P6-5）；Recover/Sweeper 归 REV-P6-6。
mustDo: 任何 PSP 副作用前 durable requested 已落库，且只由 ExecuteJob 调 Refunds::Execute（生产无 request/业务事务内同步 PSP 退款路径）
ExecuteJob 幂等：终态（processing/succeeded/failed/ambiguous/manual_review/canceled）不重复执行；重试不产生第二笔 PSP 退款

gateway cancel（completed）登记 durable 退款请求并立即成功，不再链内同步 PSP / 不回滚取消链

mustNotDo: 在 Admin/取消/业务事务内同步 gateway.credit（REV-INV-03）
